description: Golden SQL pairs for shoppers, customer profiles, membership tiers, loyalty points, and geographic distribution.

sql_pairs.question: List all customers who have placed orders with a total lifetime spend greater than $500.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT u.id, u.email, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS customer_name, cp.membership_tier, cp.lifetime_spend, cp.lifetime_orders_count FROM users u JOIN customer_profiles cp ON u.id = cp.user_id WHERE cp.lifetime_spend > 500.00 ORDER BY cp.lifetime_spend DESC;

sql_pairs.question: How many customer accounts are in each membership tier?
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT membership_tier, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, ROUND(AVG(lifetime_spend), 2) AS avg_lifetime_spend, ROUND(AVG(loyalty_points), 0) AS avg_loyalty_points FROM customer_profiles GROUP BY membership_tier ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

sql_pairs.question: Which customers have the highest loyalty rewards points balance?
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT u.id, u.email, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS customer_name, cp.membership_tier, cp.loyalty_points FROM users u JOIN customer_profiles cp ON u.id = cp.user_id ORDER BY cp.loyalty_points DESC LIMIT 10;

sql_pairs.question: Show the number of customers registered by state.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT ua.state_province AS state, COUNT(DISTINCT ua.user_id) AS customer_count FROM user_addresses ua WHERE ua.is_default = 1 GROUP BY ua.state_province ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 15;

sql_pairs.question: List all Platinum VIP customers with their email and phone number.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT u.id, u.email, u.phone, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS customer_name, cp.lifetime_spend FROM users u JOIN customer_profiles cp ON u.id = cp.user_id WHERE cp.membership_tier = 'platinum' ORDER BY cp.lifetime_spend DESC;

sql_pairs.question: How many new user accounts were registered in each month of 2025?
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS registration_month, COUNT(*) AS new_users_count FROM users GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY registration_month ASC;

sql_pairs.question: Find customers located in California who have completed at least one order.
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.email, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS customer_name, ua.city, cp.lifetime_orders_count FROM users u JOIN user_addresses ua ON u.id = ua.user_id JOIN customer_profiles cp ON u.id = cp.user_id WHERE ua.state_province = 'CA' AND cp.lifetime_orders_count > 0 LIMIT 10;

sql_pairs.question: What is the average lifetime spend of Gold tier vs Silver tier members?
sql_pairs.sql: SELECT membership_tier, ROUND(AVG(lifetime_spend), 2) AS avg_spend, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM customer_profiles WHERE membership_tier IN ('gold', 'silver') GROUP BY membership_tier;
